title: Ravens Reach Online Early Access
author: Naayte
selftext:
Marking this as "Demo" since [www.ravensreach.online](https://ravensreach.online) will likely get a full server wipe before actual launch.

For fans of Torn, Melvor, Simple MMO, Valheim, and MafiaWars, Ravens Reach will be a persistent TBMMO with player-gathered and crafted items, economies, clans, Warbands, PvP, PvE, that rewards those who love the grind.

My tech stack has recently included Linear.app which has been a game changer. Aside from that, Claude Code, manual coding, and GitHub are the main tools I've been using.

I am looking for about \~100 Players to test out the initial launch in a couple weeks before the game is released.

No AI art is used in the game.

Features for the roadmap are already planned, artists are on standby for an upgrade to the UI and monster hunts, and much more.

Thanks for taking a look! 🙏🏻
